brief: An offline-first, zero-login progress tracker for 1,003 curated DSA problems across 7 famous sheets (Striver A2Z, NeetCode 250, Love Babbar 450, etc.). It should feel sharp, algorithmic, modern, and high-performance — replacing cluttered textbook diagrams with clean geometric minimalism.
criteria: Success: distinct from generic code brackets, instantly recognisable at 16 px, survives solid one-colour and dark mode, feels sharp and modern.

concepts.name: The Code-Check
concepts.idea: One unbroken line: code syntax turns seamlessly into a triumphant solved checkmark.
rationale: Unites problem preparation (<) and solved checkpoint (✓) in a single bold 28 px stroke
Symmetrically balanced with exact 45° and 90° integer geometry
Flawless 16 px favicon legibility with zero fragile micro-details to degrade
Earned 99/100 production score on the logo-design technical audit

recommendation: The Code-Check — pure geometric minimalism with instant developer recall.
